candidates.snippet: ### Problem or Motivation  Wally (https://www.runwally.com) is an OpenAI-compatible API for open-weight models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, MiniMax M3) by RunAnywhere. LiteLLM added it as the `wally` provider in BerriAI/litellm#45662 (base URL `https://inference.runanywhere.ai/v1`, key from `WALLY_API_KEY`).
